title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations on Searcy corridors near Harding, each paired with one verified reason to leave campus.

cards.title: Race Avenue for Mexican Food
cards.subtitle: Mi Pueblito · East Race Avenue
cards.notes: Follow East Race Avenue to Mi Pueblito when you want a locally owned Mexican restaurant close to Harding’s campus.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant stop on the East Race corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy identifies Mi Pueblito as a locally owned Mexican restaurant at 1512 E. Race Avenue.
cards.access_notes: The source verifies the address but does not publish current operating hours; check the linked business website before leaving.

cards.entity_name: The Historic Benjamin Clayton Black House and Art Gallery
cards.title: Race Street for Art and Architecture
cards.subtitle: Black House and Art Gallery · East Race Street
cards.notes: Continue west on East Race Street to tour a furnished 1874 house and see the visual-art exhibits presented inside.
cards.short_summary: A historic house and active gallery on East Race Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Searcy says the 1874 Black House is a furnished historic home with visual-art exhibits throughout the year at 300 East Race.
cards.source_title: The Historic Benjamin Clayton Black House and Art Gallery — City of Searcy
cards.access_notes: The city lists public hours as Tuesday through Saturday, noon–4 p.m.; confirm before visiting around holidays.

cards.title: Arch Avenue for Outdoor Murals
cards.subtitle: Art Alley · West Arch Avenue
cards.notes: Turn onto West Arch Avenue and walk through Art Alley to examine murals created by local artists and art students.
cards.short_summary: A concentrated outdoor mural stop in downtown Searcy.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy describes Art Alley as a collection of murals by community artists and locates it at 218 West Arch in downtown Searcy.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies an outdoor alley but gives no formal access schedule; visit in daylight and observe posted conditions.

cards.title: Spring Street for an Art Deco Screen
cards.subtitle: Rialto Theater · Race and Spring streets
cards.notes: Pause at the Race–Spring corner to photograph the neon marquee, then check the Rialto’s schedule for a single-screen movie.
cards.short_summary: An Art Deco cinema anchoring the downtown corner.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy places the Rialto at Race and Spring streets and documents its Art Deco styling, neon marquee and movie programming.
cards.access_notes: Admission is required for films, and the source says new shows premiere Friday evenings; verify the current program before going.

cards.title: Spring Street for a Bakery Counter
cards.subtitle: WildFlour Bakery · North Spring Street
cards.notes: Head north on Spring Street to find WildFlour Bakery, a locally owned downtown bakery with a clearly documented storefront.
cards.short_summary: A locally owned bakery on the Spring Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy lists WildFlour Bakery at 119 North Spring Street and categorizes it as a downtown, locally owned bakery.
cards.access_notes: The source verifies the storefront and address but does not publish current hours; confirm availability before visiting.

cards.title: Main Street for Kolaches
cards.subtitle: Wild Sweet Williams · South Main Street
cards.notes: Walk or drive down South Main Street to choose from the bakery’s photographed fruit and savory kolaches or sandwiches.
cards.short_summary: A locally owned bakery destination south of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy lists Wild Sweet Williams as a locally owned bakery at 504 South Main Street and shows its fruit and savory kolaches.
cards.access_notes: The source verifies the address and bakery category but does not provide current hours; check the linked business site first.

cards.title: Beebe Capps for Mediterranean Food
cards.subtitle: Greek House · East Beebe Capps Expressway
cards.notes: Take East Beebe Capps Expressway to Greek House for a Mediterranean menu documented with gyros, flatbreads and sandwiches.
cards.short_summary: A Mediterranean restaurant on the Beebe Capps corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy identifies Greek House as a locally owned Mediterranean restaurant at 1211 E. Beebe Capps Expressway.
cards.access_notes: The source confirms the address and restaurant type but not current operating hours; consult the linked business website.

cards.entity_name: Janett and Larry Crain Memorial Library
cards.title: Beebe Capps for Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Crain Memorial Library · West Beebe Capps Expressway
cards.notes: Cross to West Beebe Capps Expressway and use the library’s study rooms, recording studio, computer lab or exhibition gallery.
cards.short_summary: A modern public library with dedicated study facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy locates the Crain Memorial Library at 1609 W. Beebe Capps Expressway and documents study rooms, a recording studio and gallery.
cards.access_notes: Library access is public, but room reservations and service availability may vary; consult the library’s linked official site.

cards.title: Davis Drive for Courts and a Playground
cards.subtitle: Berryhill Park · Davis Drive
cards.notes: Turn onto Davis Drive for a park break at Berryhill, where city sources document a playground plus tennis and pickleball courts.
cards.short_summary: A city park recreation stop on Davis Drive.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy lists Berryhill Park at 501 Davis Drive, while the City of Searcy identifies Berryhill’s courts and playground facilities.
cards.access_notes: City park rules state that parks are open from sunup to sundown; observe posted court and facility notices.

cards.title: Highway 367 for Roller Skating
cards.subtitle: Searcy Skate · Highway 367 South
cards.notes: Follow Highway 367 South to lace up on Searcy Skate’s maple rink or add arcade games to an off-campus group outing.
cards.short_summary: A roller rink and arcade along Highway 367 South.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy locates Searcy Skate at 3579 Highway 367 South and documents a 14,000-square-foot maple rink and arcade games.
cards.access_notes: Skating and arcade activities require payment; the source does not provide current public-session hours, so verify before departure.
